We believe creating the data to teach these systems deserves the same rigor as model development. Sieve brings together global collection operations, exabyte-scale infrastructure and multimodal research to turn real-world experience into training data.

Our researchers work alongside our operations and infrastructure teams, translating insights from model training and evaluation into decisions about what we capture, how we curate it and how our systems evolve. We believe this close connection between data production and model development is essential to building AI that can understand and act in the world.
